name: Methane Flue
disable: DC 28 Survival check to dig around the vent in a way that diffuses the fumes

items.name: Flame Spurt
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of the flue

---

Effect A fiery geyser of flaming gas explodes from the ground. Creatures within 5 feet of the flue take 4d10 fire damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save); creatures that fail the save also take 4d10 persistent,fire damage.

text: Invisible but highly flammable natural gas has built up beneath the ground, where geological pressure can ignite it.
